applies_to: Greystone QVRF gas detection transmitters (electrochemical toxic, catalytic combustible and NDIR CO2 / CH4 / refrigerant sensors) with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The QVRF is a gas transmitter that can run as an MS/TP master or slave. It reports the gas concentration and sensor temperature, has two writable alarm levels and two relay outputs that the device itself drives at priority 16.
notes: The PICS object list calls AI 1 "MCU Temperature" and the AVs "Alarm On / Alarm Off"; names here are from the per-object property tables.
Units of AI 0 and the alarm levels depend on the sensor; the PICS example shows % (%LFL).
A Network Port object (MS/TP Port) holds MAC, max master and baud rate (default 38400).

source.title: QVRF Gas Transmitter BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance (PIC) Statement

integration.summary: Read AI 0 for the gas level and the two relay BOs for alarm state; alarm on/off levels are AV 0 and AV 1.
setup: Device object ID prints as device 4005.
MS/TP MAC, max master and baud (9600-76800, default 38400) are in the Network Port object.
gotchas: The device commands the relays at priority 16, so any BMS write at priority 1-15 takes precedence.

points.name: Gas Concentration
points.description: Gas reading; units follow the sensor (e.g. %LFL)
